name: Monument vs Grow Therapy
title: Monument vs Grow Therapy: Alcohol Treatment vs General Credentialing
description: Compare Monument (specialized online alcohol treatment) vs Grow Therapy (general therapist credentialing). Understand specialized treatment platforms vs practice infrastructure.

summary.bottom_line: Monument and Grow Therapy serve entirely different purposes. Monument is a patient-facing online alcohol treatment platform ($25/session with insurance) offering therapy, medication (naltrexone, Vivitrol), and the Sinclair Method in 18 states. Grow Therapy is a provider-facing credentialing platform helping therapists accept insurance across all 50 states. Patients seeking alcohol treatment use Monument; therapists building practices use Grow.

key_differences.services: Monument: Care delivery + medication | Grow: Practice infrastructure

sections.heading: Different Market Positions
sections.content: Monument and Grow Therapy operate in completely different segments. Monument is a patient-facing telehealth platform specializing in alcohol use disorder, offering therapy, medication-assisted treatment (naltrexone, Vivitrol), and community support. Grow Therapy is a provider-facing platform helping therapists get credentialed with insurance companies and manage their practices. If you're seeking alcohol treatment, use Monument. If you're a therapist, use Grow.

sections.heading: Monument's Specialty
sections.content: Monument focuses exclusively on helping people change their relationship with alcohol. Key features include FDA-approved medications (naltrexone daily or Vivitrol injection, acamprosate, disulfiram), explicit support for the Sinclair Method, free therapist-moderated support groups, and 24/7 anonymous community forums. In May 2025, Monument expanded into primary and urgent care, but alcohol treatment remains core.

recommendations.when: You're a patient seeking treatment for alcohol use disorder, especially if interested in medication-assisted treatment or the Sinclair Method.
You're a therapist wanting to accept insurance clients, regardless of specialty.
You're a therapist using Grow Therapy who wants to refer clients with alcohol issues to Monument's specialized platform.

faqs.q: Can a therapist use Grow Therapy to treat alcohol use disorder?
faqs.a: Yes. Therapists can specialize in substance use while using Grow Therapy for credentialing and billing. Monument is an alternative for patients wanting medication-assisted treatment they may not offer.

faqs.q: Does Monument work for general anxiety and depression?
faqs.a: Monument expanded to offer general therapy (depression, anxiety) in May 2025, but its core specialty remains alcohol treatment. For general mental health, Grow Therapy helps you find a broad network of therapists.

faqs.q: What is the Sinclair Method that Monument offers?
faqs.a: The Sinclair Method involves taking naltrexone before drinking to reduce alcohol's rewarding effects over time. Monument explicitly supports this evidence-based approach, which isn't offered by most general therapy platforms.
